_comment: Portable project MCP configuration for Claude Code, Kimi Code, and compatible clients

simple-mcp._info: Simple MCP server. 'bin/simple_mcp_server' is kept deliberately: it is the only spelling valid on BOTH platforms, and NO single string satisfies every spawn mechanism (measured 2026-09-01 on Windows 11, node v20.12.1 spawnSync matrix). Claude Code resolves the launcher itself and connects — 'claude mcp list' reported 'simple-mcp: bin/simple_mcp_server - OK Connected' on 4 of 5 runs (the one failure was a 7-server-at-once contention run, not the form), and this guard's own initialize handshake returns serverInfo.name=simple-mcp-full via PATHEXT resolution to bin\simple_mcp_server.cmd. A cmd.exe-mediated spawn (node shell:true, or node spawning a .cmd) rejects any forward-slash relative path with rc=1 "'bin' is not recognized as an internal or external command" — 'bin/simple_mcp_server' rc=1, 'bin/simple_mcp_server.cmd' rc=1, './bin/simple_mcp_server.cmd' rc=1; only 'bin\simple_mcp_server.cmd' works under BOTH node shell modes (rc=0, serverInfo), and that spelling is ENOENT on POSIX. Clients that spawn through cmd.exe must therefore use config/mcp/win/.mcp.json, which declares the backslash form. Verified by scripts/check/check-mcp-config-launchable.shs (spec: test/03_system/check/mcp_config_declared_command_launchable_spec.spl). Perf, measured 2026-09-01 on Windows: initialize round-trip 3.6s, init+tools/call 4.5-4.7s, peak RSS ~259 MB (interpreted via bin/release/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/simple.exe, md5 d52d770724a9f8797e98ac7819709ab9).

simple-lsp-mcp._info: Compiled Simple LSP MCP server via the cached native wrapper (hash-admitted + tools/call-probed). Same cross-platform launch constraint as simple-mcp above: the forward-slash form is kept because it is the only spelling valid on both platforms; cmd.exe-spawning clients must use config/mcp/win/.mcp.json. Measured 2026-09-01 on Windows: 'claude mcp list' reported 'OK Connected' on 5 of 5 runs, and the guard's initialize handshake returns serverInfo.name=simple-lsp-mcp via PATHEXT resolution to bin\simple_lsp_mcp_server.cmd. SIMPLE_EXECUTION_MODE=interpreter is load-bearing and is restored here after being dropped in an earlier edit: it is inherited by the query_visibility child, and dropping it regressed the lsp_symbols call from 3.68s to 7.96s. On Windows bin\simple_lsp_mcp_server.cmd also defaults it in its :source branch, so the two agree.

t32-mcp._info: TRACE32 runtime MCP tools for live session control (35 tools). Restored 2026-09-13: this entry and t32-lsp-mcp were deleted from THIS file as collateral damage by 27e6c7ccaa5 ('fix(js+snpm): ...'), and again from config/mcp/win/.mcp.json by 0b70f9ed79e — two unrelated commits that snapshotted stale copies. Because Claude Code loads the ROOT .mcp.json (confirmed 2026-09-13: 'claude mcp list' shows simple-mcp as 'bin/simple_mcp_server', the root spelling), that root deletion is the reason t32 MCP 'did not work at all'; restoring only the win/ copy would not have fixed it. The extensionless forward-slash spelling is the pre-deletion form and matches simple-mcp above: it is the only string valid on BOTH platforms, and on Windows PATHEXT resolves it to bin\t32_mcp_server.cmd. Verified 2026-09-13 on Windows by piping initialize + tools/list into the resolved wrapper: serverInfo.name=simple-mcp-t32 v0.1.2, 35 tools. Verified 2026-09-24 on POSIX (macOS host): the sh wrapper no longer exits 127; it runs the frontend via the seed runtime. Observed failure mode when the t32_mcp frontend cannot compile is exit 1 with a compile error ('undefined identifier: i64' - the removed i64() cast builtin in t32_mcp/ctypes_bridge.spl, fixed by ormastes/trace32_tools PR #1, merged). After the fix the wrapper answers initialize and tools/list (36 tools); it runs the source entrypoint interpreted (standalone SMF cannot embed interpreter-required constructs) and defaults SIMPLE_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB to 512. SIMPLE_EXECUTION_MODE=interpreter added 2026-09-24: t32_mcp_server.cmd falls through to the interpreted src entry (no native t32_mcp_server.exe for this triple); on Windows this host measured initialize at 62.2s under the seed's default JIT — over Claude Code's 30s CONNECT_TIMEOUT — vs 19.8s under the interpreter, the same JIT-corruption/perf gap already documented for simple-mcp and simple-lsp-mcp above.

t32-lsp-mcp._info: TRACE32 CMM analysis MCP tools for parse, diagnostics, completions, hover, symbols, definition, and validation. Restored alongside t32-mcp; same deletion, same spelling constraint, same unverified-on-POSIX caveat. SIMPLE_EXECUTION_MODE=interpreter added 2026-09-24 for consistency with t32-mcp; measured 3.66s either way on this host but keeps the two entries aligned.

spipe._info: SPipe MCP from the pinned .spipe/spipe package. The Node server exposes the full 27-tool surface, including scoped research and review guidance, without requiring a Simple bootstrap.
